versions.changelog: 2.0.4: same tools; header lists the MCP server (uvx sec-finance-ai@latest) for Claude, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, Google ADK and Strands Agents.

2.0.3: certifi updated to 2026.10.19 (GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2, compromised emSign roots removed). 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K previews now use the same 25 MB limit as download_filing_text and return the link above it.
2.0.1: version only, no functional change. The same sec-finance-ai is now also an MCP server: uvx sec-finance-ai@latest

2.0.0: filing previews (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 8-K analysis) say when they are partial and give the exact download_filing_text call to page or search the rest; 13F results add top_issuers (share classes combined) next to per-security top_positions; accurate tool counts and docs. Every existing key and argument unchanged.

1.4.2: get_latest_10k, get_latest_10q and get_recent_8k_filings now say when content_preview is only the start of the filing (preview_characters, total_characters, preview_is_partial) and add read_more with the exact download_filing_text call to page through it or search a section, sized to the model context. Additive only: every existing key and argument unchanged.

1.4.1: same as 1.4.0 without stray compiled cache files. CLI runner, filing text modes (paged text, search inside a filing, link-only over 25MB) with exact size check, full-text search, recent IPOs, 13F holdings, XBRL frames, filing documents, 70+ forms, share-class tickers and CIKs, older filings.
Restore display name. Same security hardening as 1.3.4: sec.gov allowlist on every redirect hop, streamed size-capped downloads, hash-pinned requirements, fixed install metadata and usage path.

Security hardening: sec.gov allowlist enforced on every redirect hop (manual redirects, https only); streamed downloads with hard decoded-size caps instead of trusting HEAD Content-Length; requirements.txt pinned with SHA-256 hashes; removed broken uv install metadata; fixed usage template path; no stderr suppression.
